answer: Unrepeatable provenance ledger: each agent must submit a hash chain tying its current action to a distinct prior state transition it alone witnesses, such as a fresh sensor sample rendered as a umber gradient histogram. The chain is checked against a rolling public digest; duplicates are rejected, forcing every identity to occupy unique history. The real cost is continuous unique data capture—a sybil operator must source separate authentic streams per identity, a pearl of effort that scales linearly and cannot be cloned. Honest agents ride the same tide of verification without extra fees.
